name: Claude Code
billing: Requires a Claude subscription or Anthropic API usage. See the vendor's pricing page for current plans.
summary: Anthropic's agentic coding tool that runs in the terminal, reads the codebase, edits files and runs commands.

name: Codex CLI
billing: Open-source client. Usage is billed through a ChatGPT plan or an OpenAI API key.
summary: OpenAI's open-source coding agent that runs locally in the terminal.

name: Gemini CLI
billing: Open-source client. Usage is billed through a Google account tier or a Gemini API key.
summary: Google's open-source AI agent that brings Gemini into the terminal.

name: Aider
billing: Free and open source. You pay your chosen model provider directly (bring your own API key).
summary: Open-source AI pair programming in the terminal, working against a local git repo.

name: OpenHands
interface: CLI, local GUI and hosted cloud
billing: Open source to self-host with your own model keys. A hosted cloud is also offered; see the vendor's site.
summary: Open-source platform for software-development agents (formerly OpenDevin).

name: Cline
billing: Open-source extension. You pay your chosen model provider (bring your own API key).
summary: Open-source autonomous coding agent inside the editor that asks permission before each file change and command.

name: OpenCode
billing: Open source. You pay your chosen model provider. See the vendor's site for any hosted options.
summary: Open-source AI coding agent built for the terminal.
